name: Quad Turn
description: The picture is cut into square tiles that turn in blocks of four like little turntables, a quarter turn at a time on two staggered grids, lifting over their neighbours and scrambling the first clip; a wave flips the tiles over to the second clip, then the blocks turn back the same way until every tile is home. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tiles
params.description: Number of tiles along the short side of the frame

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the first and the last block of each turn, as a part of the turn

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows cast by the lifted tiles

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color of the tray seen under the turning blocks
